title: Kya Yateemi Hai
body:
haye jab shaam e ghariban ka andhera chaaya
dhoondne baap ko maqtal may gayi ek dukhiya
darmiyan laashon ke ek laasha e besar dekha
aayi us laash se awaaz sakina aaja
jab suni baap ki awaaz to royi bacchi
laash e besar se lipat kar ye fughan karne lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad ye ehsaas hua hai baba
kya yateemi hai ye ab mujhpe khula hai baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aag daaman may lagata hai sitamgar koi
koi kaano se gohar cheen raha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
haath kaano pe dhare di ye sakina ne sada
khoon is khaak may mera bhi mila hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap pehchaan na paoge yaqeen hai mujhko
haal jo aap ki beti ka hua hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zibha se pehle tujhe pani diya zaalim ne
ya gala khusk tera kaata gaya hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
looto sadaat ko abbas nahi hai baaqi
shor hai samt yehi goonj raha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera pehlu bhi hai dadi ki tarha se zakhmi
pursa ummat ne ye mujhko bhi diya hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
uthke ammu se mere kehdo ke ab aajaye
dashte pur haul may dam ghutne laga hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj sar rakh ke sakina kahan soye bolo
saara seena tera teeron se chida hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tashna sehne hai sitam mujhko sitamgaaron ke
shaam tak ab ye muqaddar may likha hai baba
kya yateemi hai...
aap ke baad...
author: Jaffer Tashna
